_comment: Neo4j: structural knowledge graph for deep-research. Stores Paper, Author, and Topic nodes with CITES, AUTHORED_BY, TAGGED_WITH, and RELATED_TO relationships. Enables graph traversal queries: finding related papers, citation chains, co-author networks, and thematic clusters. Not in base because it is specific to knowledge persistence workflows.
_docker_image: neo4j:5 — see scripts/setup-env.js for Docker Compose setup
